content.short: Link-In-Bio creator profiles with Cardano Stickers to fund your creative journey & build a community of true fans.
content.description:
Creatious supports creators by providing an easy way to sell Cardano Stickers along their entire journey. Stickers work like a web3 tip-jar with superpowers. Fans support their creators by collecting a sticker and may get various rewards in return.

Stickers are made of an original image that can be minted unlimitedly - or until the creator decides to pause or replace a Sticker - and has all the same technical benefits of NFTs, without the problems that scarcity brings.

Specific use cases for Stickers include whitelisting for upcoming releases, funding work-in-progress or related minting and service fees, providing token-gated exclusive content to fans and many more.
